Callout.Name: Poaching in the Park
Callout.Message: Shots heard in the park after closing.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle at a fire trail, no persons seen.

Script.Line: Shots, after closing, from the treeline.
That is not a licensed hunter. The season ended a month ago.
Assume they are armed and assume they will run.

Lines.Approach: Shots after dark and a truck on the fire trail. Assume they are armed.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
